parsed.name: 串口通信组件
parsed.description: 基于 pySerial 的非实体软件通信组件，用于实验系统通过串口与各类仪器或控制板建立连接、发送数据、读取返回内容，并执行简单的命令-响应式查询。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software communication component based on pySerial, used in laboratory systems to connect to instruments or controller boards over a serial port, send data, read returned content, and perform simple command-response queries.

actions.description_en: Write data to the serial port.
Read data from the serial port.

actions.description_en: Send a command through the serial port and read the response.
